name: launchdarkly
description: Connect LaunchDarkly to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use LaunchDarkly MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect LaunchDarkly to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with feature flags and experiments using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my LaunchDarkly workspace.
Find anything in LaunchDarkly that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review feature flags and experiments in LaunchDarkly.
